title: Profile-DP: Differential Privacy for User-Controlled Profile Release in Personalized LLM Inference
abstract: arXiv:2610.27213v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Personalized large language models (LLMs) increasingly rely on profile-conditioned inference, pairing public requests with rich, user-specific facts. This paradigm exposes the user profile itself, together with the user's explicit sharing preferences. We introduce Profile-DP, a policy-aware local differential privacy framework designed specifically for user-profile release in personalized LLM inference. Profile-DP provably bounds the release of user-withheld facts while treating public instructions, profile schemas, and authorized facts as public side information. By generating a privatized profile that composes with the public instruction prior to answer generation, our framework decouples formal privacy guarantees from downstream model behavior. translated_title: Profile-DP：个性化大语言模型推理中用户可控档案发布的差分隐私
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.27213v1 公告类型：交叉（cross）。摘要：个性化大语言模型（LLM）日益依赖于基于用户档案的条件推理，将公开请求与丰富的用户特定事实信息相结合。这一范式暴露了用户档案本身以及用户明确的共享偏好。我们提出了 Profile-DP，一个专门为个性化 LLM 推理中用户档案发布而设计的、策略感知的本地差分隐私框架。Profile-DP 可证明地限制用户不愿公开的事实的泄露，同时将公开指令、档案模式和已授权事实视为公开的辅助信息。通过生成一个在答案生成前与公开指令相结合的隐私化档案，我们的框架将形式化的隐私保证与下游模型行为解耦。我们开发了两种满足 Profile-DP 的有限域机制：DP-SLOT 独立地对受保护属性进行扰动，而 DP-BLOCK 则利用公开的语义决策来协调受保护属性的发布。
tldr: 该论文提出了 Profile-DP，一种策略感知的本地差分隐私框架，可在个性化大语言模型推理中可证明地保护用户不愿公开的档案信息，并将隐私保证与下游模型行为解耦，同时提供了 DP-SLOT 和 DP-BLOCK 两种满足该框架的实现机制。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Profile-DP, a policy-aware local differential privacy framework that provably bounds the release of user-withheld profile facts in personalized LLM inference while decoupling formal privacy guarantees from downstream model behavior, realized through two finite-domain mechanisms: DP-SLOT and DP-BLOCK.
